name: typing-indicator
title: Typing indicator
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Polite live region that names who is typing, including “Ana and 2 others are typing…”. Pass names to draw the row without a presence provider.

meta.descriptionEs: Región en vivo que dice quién escribe.

examples.title: Campo
examples.description: Marina escribe, o Priya dentro de la sala.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: Cero, uno, dos y varios nombres.

api.name: names
api.description: Presentational names. When set, the row does not read presence.

api.name: dots
api.description: Shows three dots. Opacity only, and it stops when motion is reduced.

api.name: field
api.description: Presence key that is true while typing. Default isTyping. Ignored when names is set.

api.name: label
api.description: Override the sentence. Default is English.

docs: Fuente: concepto visual de Divan Raj (@desdivj), https://x.com/desdivj/status/2119738295039250507. Licencia: sin licencia, clean-room. Sin names, sigue exigiendo PresenceProvider y aria-live polite. Con names, la fila es presentacional y no lee presencia. Si el CLI pregunta si debe sobrescribir un primitivo, responde no.
